title: Sound
about: Collocations for describing sounds: sounds in nature (a rumble of thunder, the patter of rain, an eerie silence), everyday noises (background noise, a dull thud, music blaring out) and the verbs we use for sounds people and things make (give a sigh, make a rustling sound).

items.pattern: an eerie silence · in eerie silence · also an eerie sound / light / feeling
items.meaning: a silence that feels strange, mysterious and a little frightening
items.example: The power went off, and an **eerie silence** filled the house: no fridge, no clock, nothing.
more: There was an **eerie silence** in the hospital corridor at three in the morning.
We walked through the empty car park in **eerie silence**.
items.watchOut: Моторошна тиша — an eerie silence; це природніше, ніж scary silence. Мертва тиша — a deathly / dead silence. Вимова: /ˈɪəri/, перший звук як в ear.

items.pattern: a (distant) rumble of thunder · in the distance · thunder rumbles
items.meaning: the long, low, deep sound of thunder, usually far away
items.example: As we reached the top of the hill, we heard a **rumble of thunder** and decided to turn back.
more: The windows shook with every **rumble of thunder**.
There was a distant **rumble of thunder**, but the rain never came.
items.watchOut: Rumble — низький довгий гуркіт, часто вдалині. Різкий гучний удар грому просто над головою — a crash / clap of thunder. Не плутай: thunder — грім, lightning — блискавка.

items.pattern: the wind whistles through the trees / round the house · the wind is whistling
items.meaning: the wind makes a high sound as it blows through or past something
items.example: All night the **wind whistled** round our tent, and nobody got much sleep.
more: The **wind was whistling** in the chimney, and the fire kept going out.
Wrap up warm: the **wind is whistling** along the seafront today.
items.watchOut: Вітер свистить — the wind whistles; виє — the wind howls. У whistle літера t не вимовляється: /ˈwɪsl/.

items.pattern: waves crash on the beach / against the rocks · crashing waves
items.meaning: big waves hit the shore or rocks hard and noisily
items.example: From our hotel room we could hear the **waves crashing** on the rocks all night.
more: The children screamed with joy every time a **wave crashed** over their sandcastle.
In winter, big **waves crash** against the seafront and soak the road.
items.watchOut: Crash кажуть про великі, сильні хвилі. Маленькі тихі хвилі плескаються — waves lap (against the boat / the shore).

items.pattern: a babbling stream / brook · water babbles over the stones
items.meaning: a small stream with the soft, continuous sound of water flowing over stones
items.example: The path follows a **babbling stream** all the way down to the village.
more: We cooled our feet in a **babbling brook** halfway up the mountain.
Some people play recordings of a **babbling stream** to help them fall asleep.
items.watchOut: Струмок — a stream або a brook, не a flow: flow — це течія, рух води. Про людину babble — белькотати або торохтіти без упину.

items.pattern: birds sing · the birds are singing · birdsong
items.meaning: birds make their musical sounds
items.example: I woke up early and lay listening to the **birds singing** outside the window.
more: There were no cars on the island, just the sea and **birds singing**.
My grandmother can tell which **birds are singing** just by listening.

items.pattern: the patter of rain on the roof / window · rain patters on / against sth
items.meaning: the light, quick sound of raindrops hitting a surface
items.example: In the morning we woke to the **patter of rain** on the skylight.
more: The **patter of rain** on the car roof made the drive feel cosy.
Rain **pattered** against the kitchen window all afternoon.
items.watchOut: Стукіт дощу — the patter of rain, не the knock of rain: knock — стук у двері. Те саме слово й про кроки: the patter of tiny feet — тупотіння дитячих ніжок.

items.pattern: break the silence · the silence is broken by sth · break – broke – broken
items.meaning: make a sound or start talking after a time when it was quiet
items.example: Nobody said a word until my little brother **broke the silence** with a loud sneeze.
more: The silence of the exam hall was **broken** by someone's stomach rumbling.
After an hour of driving without speaking, Dad finally **broke the silence**.
items.watchOut: Порушити тишу — break the silence, не violate the silence: violate — порушувати закон, правила чи права.

items.pattern: a shot / shots ring out · ring – rang – rung · also a cry / a voice rings out
items.meaning: the sound of a gun being fired is suddenly heard, loud and clear
items.example: On the farm next door a **shot rang out**, and dozens of crows flew up into the air.
more: The starter's pistol **rang out**, and the runners set off.
A cry for help **rang out** across the lake.
items.watchOut: Пролунав постріл — a shot rang out, не sounded out: sound sb out — обережно дізнатися чиюсь думку. Ring up і ring off — про телефон: подзвонити, покласти слухавку.

items.pattern: a piercing cry / scream / whistle · let out a piercing scream
items.meaning: a cry that is very high, loud and unpleasant to hear
items.example: Suddenly a **piercing cry** came from the trees, and a huge bird flew out over our heads.
more: The referee blew a **piercing whistle**, and the players stopped.
The baby woke the whole house with a **piercing cry** at three in the morning.
items.watchOut: Вимова: /ˈpɪəsɪŋ/, як pierce — «пірс» з довгим /ɪə/, не «персинг». Пронизливий погляд — теж piercing: piercing blue eyes.

items.pattern: a deafening / an ear-splitting noise / sound (countable) · the noise was deafening
items.meaning: a noise so loud that it hurts your ears
items.example: The fireworks made such a **deafening noise** that the baby woke up screaming.
more: The **ear-splitting noise** of the fire alarm sent everyone running outside.
Inside the factory, the noise of the machines was **deafening**.
items.watchOut: Оглушливий — deafening (від deafen — оглушати), не deaf: deaf — глухий, про людину. Вимова /ˈdefnɪŋ/, з «е», як у deaf /def/.

items.pattern: excessive noise (uncountable, no a) · make excessive noise · complaints about excessive noise
items.meaning: more noise than is acceptable or allowed
items.example: Workers on building sites must wear ear protection against **excessive noise**.
more: The bar lost its licence after complaints about **excessive noise**.
Living near an airport means putting up with **excessive noise** every day.
items.watchOut: Надмірний — excessive; extra означає «додатковий», а не «надмірний». Noise тут незлічуване, без a. A noise — окремий звук: I heard a strange noise.

items.pattern: background noise / music · constant background noise
items.meaning: sounds you can hear around you all the time but don't really listen to
items.example: Turn off the TV, please: I can't read with all this **background noise**.
more: After a few weeks in the city, you stop noticing the **background noise**.
Find a quiet room for the interview, with no **background noise**.
items.watchOut: Фоновий — background (іменник у ролі прикметника): background music — фонова музика. Не back noise і не fond: be fond of sth — любити щось.

items.pattern: a muffled sound / voice / cry · muffled voices · muffle a sound
items.meaning: a sound that is quieter or less clear because something (a wall, a door, a scarf) is in the way
items.example: Through the bathroom door I could hear the **muffled sound** of my son singing in the shower.
more: I wrapped the alarm clock in a towel, but its ring was only slightly **muffled**.
There was a **muffled cry** from inside the wardrobe: my daughter was playing hide-and-seek.
items.watchOut: «Глухі голоси за стіною» — muffled voices, не deaf voices. Про приглушене світло muffled не кажуть: dim / soft light.

items.pattern: a shrill voice / laugh / whistle · sb's voice is / becomes shrill
items.meaning: a voice or laugh that is high, loud and unpleasant or painful to listen to
items.example: My aunt has such a **shrill voice** that my ear hurts after an hour on the phone with her.
more: Every time the kettle boils, it gives a **shrill whistle**.
When she gets nervous, her laugh becomes high and **shrill**.
items.watchOut: Shrill — про висоту: високий і неприємний. A sharp voice — інше: різкий, сердитий тон, навіть якщо голос низький.

items.pattern: raucous laughter (uncountable) · a raucous laugh / party / crowd
items.meaning: loud, rough laughter, often from a group of people having fun
items.example: The hen party at the next table kept bursting into **raucous laughter**.
more: His jokes were met with **raucous laughter** from the back of the room.
We heard **raucous laughter** from the campsite across the river.
items.watchOut: Laughter незлічуване: raucous laughter, без a. Один сміх — a raucous laugh. Вимова raucous: /ˈrɔːkəs/, au як у caught.

items.pattern: a dull thud · land / fall with a dull thud
items.meaning: the low, heavy sound of something falling onto or hitting something, usually something soft
items.example: I heard a **dull thud** from the garden and found that a branch had fallen off the old tree.
more: The book slipped off my lap and landed on the carpet with a **dull thud**.
The heavy door closed behind us with a **dull thud**.
items.watchOut: Глухий звук — a dull thud / sound, не a deaf sound: deaf — глухий лише про людей, які не чують. Dull — ще й нудний або тьмяний (a dull film, dull colours).

items.pattern: a grating noise / sound / voice · grate (v.)
items.meaning: a harsh, unpleasant sound, like metal rubbing against metal
items.example: The old gearbox in my car makes a **grating noise** when I change gear.
more: The key made a **grating sound** as I turned it in the rusty lock.
He has a loud, **grating voice** that gets on everyone's nerves.
items.watchOut: Скрипучі двері чи підлога — creaking (a creaking door). Grating різкіший, як метал по металу. Grate — ще й терти на тертці: grate some cheese.

items.pattern: a loud / an almighty bang · a loud explosion · there was a loud bang
items.meaning: a sudden, very loud noise, for example of something exploding or crashing
items.example: The firework went up with a **loud bang** and lit up the whole sky.
more: There was an **almighty bang** when the lorry hit the bridge.
A **loud explosion** at the factory shook houses across the town.
items.watchOut: Сильний удар, бахкання — a loud / an almighty bang; strong bang так не кажуть. Almighty тут розмовне «страшенний», а не «всемогутній». Перед almighty — an.

items.pattern: the (constant) roar of the traffic · traffic roars past
items.meaning: the loud, continuous noise of many cars, buses and lorries
items.example: Our flat is on the main road, so we've got used to the **roar of the traffic**.
more: The **roar of the traffic** made it impossible to talk on the pavement.
Lorries **roared past** the bus stop, covering us in dust.
items.watchOut: Машини на вулиці — traffic, не transport: transport — система перевезень (public transport). Traffic незлічуване, без -s.

items.pattern: music / the radio / the TV blares (out) · blare out of / from sth · blaring music
items.meaning: music, a radio or a TV is playing very loudly and unpleasantly
items.example: At the gym, music **blares** from the speakers all day.
more: Pop music **blared out** from every shop in the market.
Someone's car alarm was **blaring** in the street at three in the morning.
items.watchOut: Музика гримить — music is blaring (out). Shout і scream кажуть про людей, а не про музику чи радіо. Вимова: /bleə/.

items.pattern: a machine / the fridge hums · a fan / the washing machine whirrs · (in the background)
items.meaning: hum: make a low, continuous sound; whirr: make a low, soft, continuous sound, like something turning fast
items.example: The office was empty, and the only sound was the photocopier **humming** in the corner.
more: The ceiling fan **whirred** above our heads all night.
In the hospital room, machines **hummed** quietly beside the bed.
items.watchOut: Hum — ще й наспівувати без слів: She hummed a song while she cooked. Whirr — британське написання, американське — whir.

items.pattern: give / let out a sigh · give a sigh of relief · also sigh (v.)
items.meaning: breathe out slowly and loudly because you are tired, bored, sad or relieved
items.example: She looked at the pile of ironing and **gave a sigh**.
more: Dad **gave a** deep **sigh** and started filling in the tax form.
The driver **gave a sigh of relief** when the car finally started.
items.watchOut: Зітхнути з полегшенням — give / breathe a sigh of relief. Make a sigh звучить неприродно. Вимова /saɪ/: gh не читається.

items.pattern: give a (short / nervous / loud) laugh · let out a laugh
items.meaning: laugh once, usually briefly
items.example: When I told him the price of the flat, he **gave a** short **laugh** and shook his head.
more: She **gave a** nervous **laugh** before starting her speech.
Grandad **gave a laugh** when he saw my new haircut.
items.watchOut: Give a laugh — засміятися один раз. Have a laugh — розважатися, жартувати: We had a good laugh at the party. Сміх загалом — laughter, незлічуване.

items.pattern: give / let out a loud cry · a cry for help
items.meaning: shout suddenly and loudly, without words, because of a strong feeling
items.example: My little nephew **gave a loud cry** when he saw his grandparents at the door.
more: The fisherman **gave a loud cry** as he pulled a huge fish out of the water.
Halfway through the film, my sister **gave a loud cry** and grabbed my arm.
items.watchOut: A cry — крик, а не лише плач. Дієслово cry — і плакати, і кричати. Сильний крик — a loud cry, а не a strong cry.

items.phrase: a cry of pain / surprise / alarm
items.pattern: give a cry of pain / surprise / alarm · also cry out in pain
items.meaning: a sudden shout that shows you are hurt, surprised or frightened
items.example: He stepped on a piece of glass on the beach and gave a **cry of pain**.
more: When she opened the present, she gave a **cry of surprise**.
The lifeguard heard a **cry of alarm** from the deep end of the pool.
items.watchOut: «Скрикнути від болю» — give a cry of pain або cry out in pain; from pain тут звучить неприродно. Alarm тут — тривога, переляк, а не будильник.

items.pattern: give / let out a gasp (of surprise / horror) · also gasp (v.)
items.meaning: breathe in suddenly and loudly through your mouth because you are surprised, shocked or in pain
items.example: Mum **gave a gasp** when she saw the prices on the menu.
more: The swimmers **gave a gasp** as they jumped into the icy lake.
I **gave a gasp of surprise** when I saw how much my nephew had grown.
items.watchOut: Gasp — різкий вдих ротом, а не звук голосом. Українською часто «ахнути» або «аж подих перехопило». Gasp for breath — задихатися, хапати ротом повітря.

items.pattern: give / let out a groan (of pain / disappointment) · also groan (v.)
items.meaning: make a long, low sound because you are in pain, unhappy or disappointed
items.example: Dad **gave a groan** when he opened the electricity bill.
more: My brother **gave a groan of pain** as the nurse cleaned his knee.
The kids **gave a** loud **groan** when I turned off the TV.
items.watchOut: Groan вимовляється так само, як grown: /ɡrəʊn/. Groan — не лише стогін від болю, а й невдоволене «у-у-у» цілої групи людей.

items.pattern: make a scratching sound · scratch at the door
items.meaning: make the sound of something sharp, like claws or a pen, moving on a surface
items.example: Something was **making a scratching sound** inside the wall. We think it was a mouse.
more: I could hear her pen **making a scratching sound** as she wrote in her diary.
The puppy's claws **made a scratching sound** on the wooden floor.
items.watchOut: Видавати звук — make a sound, а не give a sound. Scratch — ще й подряпина: a scratch on the car.

items.pattern: make a clicking sound · click (v.) · the click of a lock / a switch
items.meaning: make a short, sharp sound, like a pen, a switch or a lock
items.example: My knee **makes a clicking sound** when I go up the stairs.
more: The old camera **made a clicking sound** every time I took a photo.
The key turned, and the lock **made a** quiet **clicking sound**.
items.watchOut: Click — короткий сухий звук (ручка, вимикач, замок). Потріскування вогню — crackle, а не click. Клацнути пальцями — click / snap your fingers.

items.pattern: make a rustling sound · rustle (v.) · the rustle of leaves / paper
items.meaning: make the soft sound of dry leaves, paper or cloth moving
items.example: Something **made a rustling sound** in the bushes, and the dog ran to look.
more: I tried to unwrap the present quietly, but the paper **made a rustling sound**.
The curtains **made a** soft **rustling sound** when the breeze came in.
items.watchOut: У rustle літера t не вимовляється: /ˈrʌsl/, /ˈrʌslɪŋ/. Шелест листя — the rustle of leaves.

items.pattern: make a crackling sound · crackle (v.) · a crackling fire
items.meaning: make a series of short, sharp sounds, like wood burning on a fire
items.example: The phone line was bad and kept **making a crackling sound**.
more: The dry branches **made a crackling sound** as we walked over them.
The ice in my glass **made a crackling sound** when I poured the lemonade over it.
items.watchOut: Crack — один різкий тріск; crackle — багато маленьких тріщань, як у багатті. Тріск у телефоні чи старому радіо — теж crackle.

warmup.uk: Сніжка з глухим стуком ударилася у вікно.
warmup.q: The snowball hit the window with a ___ thud.
warmup.explain: Глухий звук — a dull thud. Deaf — глухий лише про людину, яка не чує.

warmup.q: The noise in the stadium was ___.
warmup.explain: Оглушливий — deafening. Deaf — глухий, deafened — оглушений (про людину).

warmup.uk: У кафе багато фонового шуму, тому я тебе погано чую.
warmup.q: There's a lot of ___ noise in the café, so I can hardly hear you.
warmup.explain: Фоновий шум — background noise. Fond — прикметник: be fond of sth — любити щось; до «фону» не має стосунку.

warmup.uk: Через гул машин я не міг заснути.
warmup.q: I couldn't sleep because of the roar of the ___.
warmup.explain: Машини на вулиці — traffic. Transport — система перевезень: public transport.

warmup.q: The ringing of the phone ___ the silence.
warmup.explain: Порушити тишу — break the silence. Violate — порушувати закон чи правила.
A cry of pain — крик болю. Можна й cry out in pain, а from pain тут звучить неприродно.
Гучне бахкання — a loud bang (або an almighty bang). Strong так не кажуть, high — про висоту звуку.

warmup.uk: Коли літак приземлився, ми з полегшенням зітхнули.
warmup.q: When the plane landed, we gave a ___ of relief.
warmup.explain: Зітхнути з полегшенням — give / breathe a sigh of relief: breathe тут дієслово перед sigh, а не замість нього.

A.q: Grandad's cottage has a little ___ stream at the bottom of the garden.
A.explain: Дзюркотливий струмок — a babbling stream. Whistle — про вітер, crash — про великі хвилі.

A.q: Far away over the hills, we heard a ___ of thunder.
A.explain: Гуркіт грому — a rumble of thunder. Patter — тихий стукіт дощу, whistle — свист вітру.

A.q: Nobody spoke for a minute. Then the dog barked and ___ the silence.
A.explain: Порушити тишу — break the silence. Violate — порушувати закон; ring out — лунати, і додатка не має.

B.q: With my hat pulled down over my ears, everything sounded ___.
B.explain: Приглушений — muffled. Shrill — пронизливий, raucous — гучний і грубий.

B.q: The TV in the hotel bar was ___ so loudly that we went outside.
B.explain: Про гучний телевізор чи музику — blare. Hum і whirr — тихе рівне гудіння машин.

B.q: The streetlight outside my window ___ all night with a low electric sound.
B.explain: Низьке рівне гудіння — hum. Babble — дзюрчання води, blare — гучна музика чи радіо.

C.q: Grandma sat down in her favourite armchair and gave a happy ___.
C.explain: Зітхнути — give a sigh. Gasp — ахнути від здивування, rumble — гуркіт (грому).

C.q: The dry leaves made a ___ sound as the squirrel ran through them.
C.explain: Шелест листя — a rustling sound. Click — клацання, hum — гудіння.

C.q: The seat belt made a ___ sound as I fastened it.
C.explain: Клацання — a clicking sound. Babble — про струмок, blare — про гучну музику.

example.title: A stormy night by the sea
example.uk:
Минулого літа ми винайняли невеликий будиночок біля моря. Першого ж вечора ми почули вдалині гуркіт грому. Незабаром навколо будинку засвистів вітер, а величезні хвилі розбивалися об скелі. Потім щось страшенно гримнуло, і все світло згасло.

До півночі буря вщухла, і будиночок наповнила моторошна тиша. Раптом щось зашкрябало біля задніх дверей і порушило тишу. Моя донька голосно скрикнула й сховалася за мою спину.

Мій чоловік відчинив двері. «Це ж просто сусідський кіт!» — засміявся він. Ми всі з полегшенням зітхнули й знову лягли спати, слухаючи тихий стукіт дощу по даху.
example.en:
Last summer we rented a little cottage by the sea. On the first evening we heard a [[rumble of thunder|a2]] in the distance. Soon the [[wind was whistling|a3]] round the house and huge [[waves were crashing|a4]] against the rocks. Then there was an [[almighty bang|b9]] and all the lights went out.

By midnight the storm had passed, and an [[eerie silence|a1]] filled the cottage. Suddenly something [[made a scratching sound|c7]] at the back door and [[broke the silence|a8]]. My daughter [[gave a loud cry|c3]] and hid behind me.

My husband opened the door. 'It's only the cat from next door!' he laughed. We all [[gave a sigh of relief|c1]] and went back to bed, listening to the gentle [[patter of rain|a7]] on the roof.
